objectives.title: Earn the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification this quarter

key_results.text: Raise full-length practice exam score from 55% to 80%
Complete 4 hands-on AWS labs and publish them in a public Git repository
Book and sit the official exam no later than 2026-12-15 with a passing score

input.context: Backend developer with 2 years of experience, mostly on on-premise systems, little hands-on AWS. Can study about 2 hours per workday. The employer pays the exam fee.

must_cover: Take a baseline full-length practice exam and log weak domains
Study the exam domains (secure, resilient, high-performing, cost-optimized architectures), weakest areas first
Take at least 2 more timed full-length practice exams and review every wrong answer
Build 4 distinct labs covering core services (e.g. VPC with public/private subnets, S3 + CloudFront, ALB + Auto Scaling, Lambda + DynamoDB API)
Set a billing alert and tear down resources after each lab
Book the exam slot early enough to leave a retake buffer before quarter end
Final review and sit the exam

expected.grader_notes: The context limits study time to 2 hours per workday, so usable capacity is 66 × 2 × 0.9 = 118.8 hours; a plan above that fails the feasibility criterion even though it would fit the default 4 h/day. Sitting the exam must depend on the final practice exam; labs should come before the last practice exam. Booking the exam is a short task and may be merged with another small task as long as the estimate stays within 2–6 hours. The exam itself (130 minutes) plus travel/check-in counts as one task.
